parsed.answer: The evidence shows reverse-engineering of the TLX1/TLX3 oncogenic network identified RUNX1 as a key mediator of TLX1/TLX3-induced T-ALL and predicted a tumor-suppressor role, which was confirmed by recurrent somatic loss-of-function RUNX1 mutations in human T-ALL. Thus the mutation arm of the disjunctive claim (downregulated or mutated) is directly established, though the excerpts do not explicitly report RUNX1 downregulation in TLX1 T-ALL.
